title: Provider-neutral Forge seam for GitHub operations
summary: This change introduces a provider-neutral `Forge` trait that abstracts all code-host operations (branch creation, pull request opening, status-block writing, review posting, check-status reading, capability reporting) behind a single interface. A `GitHub` adapter implements the trait by driving the `gh` command-line tool, while a `FakeForge` in-memory double records every call for tests. The `report_change` function orchestrates the Report step in a fixed order, and the CLI commands (`review post`, `pr status apply`, `pr status refresh`) are rewired to go through the forge rather than calling `gh` directly. Pure modules (`review.rs`, `pr_status.rs`) are stripped of process-spawning code, and the `GhClient` trait gains a generic `run` method so the adapter can execute arbitrary commands.

nodes.label: osf review post
nodes.subtitle: review_post_cmd
nodes.summary: Builds a review plan from findings and summary, fetches the head commit through the GitHub adapter, and posts via post_plan which now takes a Forge.

nodes.label: osf pr status apply
nodes.subtitle: pr_status_apply_cmd
nodes.summary: Reads the pull request body and writes the status block through the forge. Dry-run still reads the body directly via the adapter's client.

nodes.label: osf pr status refresh
nodes.subtitle: pr_status_refresh_cmd
nodes.summary: Reads checks through the forge's read_check_status, builds the status block, and writes it via write_status_block.

nodes.label: osf review run --post-to
nodes.subtitle: post_run_outcome
nodes.summary: Posts a review run's outcome through the forge, using the GitHub adapter for head-commit lookup and review posting.

nodes.label: github_adapter()
nodes.subtitle: the only place that builds GitHub<RealGh>
nodes.summary: A single factory function that constructs the real GitHub adapter, keeping the concrete type out of command logic.

nodes.label: Forge trait
nodes.subtitle: create_branch, open_pull_request, write_status_block, post_review, read_check_status, capabilities
nodes.summary: The seam between the factory and a code host. Six operations, all provider-neutral, with typed request and response structs.

nodes.label: Forge data types
nodes.subtitle: PullRequestId, NewBranch, NewReview, PostedReview, Capabilities, ReadOutcome
nodes.summary: Plain serializable structs and enums that carry forge requests and answers without naming a provider.

nodes.label: report_change
nodes.subtitle: the Report step in one fixed order
nodes.summary: Opens the pull request, writes the status block, reads capabilities, posts the review only when the identity may, then reads check status. Stops at the first failed step.

nodes.label: FakeForge
nodes.subtitle: in-memory Forge double
nodes.summary: Records every call as plain data, answers from scripted sequences, and can be told to fail any of the four write operations. No process, file, network or clock work.

nodes.label: GitHub adapter
nodes.subtitle: GitHub<C: GhClient>
nodes.summary: Implements Forge by driving the gh command-line tool: API POSTs for branch and pull request creation, review posting with self-review fallback, and read commands for checks and capabilities.

nodes.label: RealGh
nodes.subtitle: the real gh command-line tool
nodes.summary: Spawns the gh binary, pipes stdin for API calls, and captures stdout, stderr and exit status. Moved here from pr_status.rs and review.rs.

nodes.label: GhClient trait
nodes.subtitle: run, view_body, view_review, view_pr_info, view_checks, edit_body
nodes.summary: Gains a generic run method that executes one gh command with optional stdin and returns the raw result. The other methods remain for body and review reads.

nodes.label: review module
nodes.subtitle: payload construction and outcome classification
nodes.summary: Loses fetch_head_sha and post_via_gh, which moved to the GitHub adapter. Keeps the pure decision logic: payload building, self-review detection, and fallback classification.

nodes.label: pr_status module
nodes.subtitle: status block parsing and gate spec
nodes.summary: Loses RealGh, which moved to the GitHub adapter. Gains parse_checks and gates_from_checks as separate pure functions, with gates_from_checks_json composing them.

edges.label: post_review

views.title: Forge seam architecture
